abstract: Looking at each measure, the groups differ in these ways. Overall, Alvenor increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Alvenor increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. This comparison was run at the Riverside Pressure Registry.

Table 6. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Side effects | 90 | 300 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Side effects | 101 | 300 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Blood pressure control | 175 | 300 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Blood pressure control | 223 | 300 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
